description.value: Crown & Thieves is a small-batch winery built inside a striking four-story faux-ruin tucked into the vines of West Kelowna, operated by winemaker Jason Parkes. Part of the Westside Wine Trail, it offers tastings, a rooftop patio with vineyard views, and a speakeasy-style venue called The Broken Hearts Club hosting live music, comedy, and cabaret. It's an eccentric, memorable stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan wine country.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Crown & Thieves is an active winery with a tasting room, rooftop patio, speakeasy venue, and wine shop in West Kelowna, with upcoming events through June 2026. Contact details (phone 778.754.6968, address 3887C Brown Rd, website crownthieves.com) all corroborate OSM data. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website. The FAQ mentions a picnic area and partial wheelchair accessibility but nothing bike-related.
concerns: OSM name uses 'and' while the website consistently uses '&' (Crown & Thieves)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active winery and tasting room on the Westside Wine Trail in West Kelowna, a natural stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan. Upcoming 2026 events and active website confirm it is open and operational.
